summary: Phase 136L, implementation. Implemented exactly records/cutover_request.schema.json and records/readiness_package.schema.json (Implementation Group 3), independently re-derived from CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.19/Sec.19.1(repaired by 136D)/Sec.20/Sec.46. Confirmed the repaired non-circular creation order (readiness_package first, cutover_request second, bound via an opaque record_reference, never a $ref edge) end-to-end in a fixture-level test proving no versioned request-v2 mechanism or identity/digest cycle exists. CutoverRequest is Tier 1 strict (target const cltr, source_authority const legacy, authorization_requirement const true); ReadinessPackage is Tier 2 (_extensions only), with state==conflict requiring at least one BLOCKING-verdict finding. Disclosed and resolved three NON-BLOCKING findings on genuine frozen-contract-text gaps/contradictions. Added 130 new focused tests. Repaired 24 stale scope-guard assertions across 6 pre-existing test files to reflect Group 3's now-legitimate existence, following the 136J/136K precedent. Combined cltr_cutover+schema_runtime suite: 834 passed, 0 failed. Fast Green: 4391 passed, identical to the 136H/136I/136J/136K baseline, zero regressions. Full unmarked suite freshly run: 20892 passed, 20 failed, 20912 total, 1228.27s -- 19 of 20 failing node IDs byte-identical to the previously classified inherited-failure set (test_advisory_runtime_contract.py, test_advisory_runtime_architecture.py, test_phase_reports.py, test_rendering_134e5.py, test_finalization_transaction_134e10.py x5, test_cltr_migration_135p_verification.py x4, test_bootstrap_todo_consistency.py x2, test_cltr_135o_integration.py x4); 1 additional failure (test_commit_push_preflight.py::test_no_repo_mutation) root-caused to this session's own concurrent task-lifecycle writes racing the test's git-status window during the background full-suite run, reproduced clean (1 passed) in isolation on a quiescent tree, disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136L-4, zero new code regressions. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative; runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. No HumanAuthorization, CutoverCandidate, Certification, or any later-group record schema, typed model, semantic validator, or authority resolver/state/pointer was created or changed. Verdict: READY FOR REQUEST AND READINESS SCHEMA INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION. Recommended next phase: 136M -- Request and Readiness Schema Independent Verification.
